Definition: Chetsron, the name of a place in Palestine; also of two Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Hezron = "surrounded by a wall"; n pr m; 1) a son of Reuben; 2) a son of Pharez and grandson of Judah; n pr loc; 3) a place in the extreme south of Judah
